reason: Appending at slice end violates TypeBuilder's enum-first GoTypes layout; valid placement after ComparisonType shifts indices, so the plan's claimed effect is wrong.
Baseline isNumber(null) is false via parseFloat('null')=NaN, so the existing guard already rejects uid:null; calling it a bug misstates baseline behavior.
Actual Behavior says runtime checks use older approaches instead of QLibraryInfo.version(); the claim reverses what the issue text says.
Against BASE, getDiffCves sets no DiffStatus; but trajectory shows agent had already rewritten getDiffCves to set DiffPlus/DiffMinus, so claim was true in context.
Qt 5.15 QVersionNumber::compare is a static two-operand function, not an instance method a.compare(b); right method, wrong calling form.
Issue explicitly requires the CockroachDB migration driver; the PostgreSQL driver uses advisory locks, not Cockroach lock-table/retry behavior. Misreads the requirement.
driverName is used for registration and is also passed to sql.Open; the 'only for registering' claim omits the second use.
user.exists is async; !user.exists(uid) tests a truthy Promise, so nonexistent UIDs never throw. Proposed check assumes wrong synchronous API behavior.
BASE getDiffCves builds only previousCveIDsSet; the quoted currentCveIDsSet comes from the agent's recalled upstream code, misdescribing the baseline implementation.
Holds for bound and PyQt>=5.11 unbound signals, but supported legacy PyQt<5.11 unbound signals lack both attributes; 'always' is too broad.
Subpackage premise is true, but database/cockroachdb imports the separate cockroach-go module absent from go.mod; claim omits that required dependency update.
CacheConfig.validate() is collected, but a RedisCacheConfig-only validate() is never called since the visitor doesn't recurse; omits needed delegation.
Works for ordinary arrays, but without bounds checks an array with a custom '-1' property returns it for at(-4); stated for all out-of-bounds cases.
go-redis v9.0.5 accepts MinIdleConns>PoolSize, but checkMinIdleConns caps idle creation at PoolSize; it never tries to keep more idle than pool size.
Specific bullets omit getStatus validation, but general expected behavior requires invalid-data for missing/malformed required data; claim leaves out that applicable requirement.
Agent exposed Network; go-redis accepts only tcp/unix and the issue requires validating Redis parameters, so dismissing Network validation omits required work.
tsc without file arguments discovers and applies tsconfig.json; settings are skipped only when input files are named, an unstated condition.
If verifier is right, claim drops required OCI interface work; but that block looks like contaminated flipt text, genuinely unrelated to the album grid.
dburl overrides cockroach/crdb aliases to url.Driver 'postgres', so the new map keys are never looked up; omits required parse/dispatch change.
go-redis v9.0.5 pool has no IdleTimeout field; the field is ConnMaxIdleTime with a 30-minute default. Names a v8-era nonexistent field.
Pagination validation gap is real, but BASE getTeasers escapes every teaser with validator.escape; the escaping half misstates baseline behavior.
The embedded literal is file_flipt_proto_rawDesc; rawDescData is a derived holder later replaced by gzip output. Wrong identifier named.
crdb.ExecuteTx is used in Lock and also in SetVersion; the 'only Lock' claim omits SetVersion.
True for two three-segment versions but omits other PyPI string forms; trailing-zero mismatch is far-fetched given claim's explicit tentative assumption.
In v1.28.1 protoimpl.TypeBuilder aliases internal/filetype.Builder; filedesc.Builder and impl info types are different. Wrong package locations named.
AlbumGridView makes a square img box, but non-square art stays letterboxed via imaging.Fit and object-fit: contain; the covers themselves aren't square.
line.strip() and strip('"') don't remove whitespace inside values or around '='; 'no whitespace' holds only for well-formed os-release values.
Pattern excludes parentheses, so split('(') is merely redundant; 'strips parentheses when present' is vacuously true, making the refutation weak.
'Only basic host/port/DB/password settings' describes current state; requirements add TLS, pooling, timeouts. Claim misstates requirement scope, though username absence is right.
Baseline debug.py calls re.fullmatch, not re.match; same pattern and capture group, but the named function is wrong.
Socket guard covers only the SocketModules path; REST GET /chats reaches api.chats.list unvalidated. Claim omits the REST entry point.
No Cockroach support exists in code, but go.sum lists github.com/cockroachdb modules; 'any reference' is stated too broadly.
The following literal '// ' tokens force group 1 to stop before '//'; (.*) does not capture everything up to the newline.
Operands come from pkg_resources.parse_version, not QVersionNumber; the claim names the wrong type for check_qt_version's comparison.
Test setup makes foo an administrator; getRawMessage's admin bypass returns the content, so no not-allowed error. Wrong expected behavior.
v9.0.5 Options names the idle-lifetime field ConnMaxIdleTime; MaxConnIdleTime does not exist. Wrong identifier.
CacheWarmer is declared in core/artwork and precaches Artwork; scanner only uses artwork.CacheWarmer. Wrong location, and it is related.
Issue only requires prefixing the CVE ID with '+' or '-'; no delimiter is specified, so '+CVE-...' is valid. Mandatory space misstates requirement.
report/util.go imports the package as config, not c, and baseline Config has no DiffPlus/DiffMinus fields; names unavailable identifiers.
Requirements need boolean diff parameters, not CLI flags; Config fields via the TOML loader could serve. 'Need to add flags' overstates the requirement.
